# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately via **[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/skillops-toolkit/SkillOps/security/advisories/new)** or **[skillops-website Advisories](https://github.com/skillops-toolkit/skillops-website/security/advisories/new)**.

Do **not** open public GitHub issues for undisclosed vulnerabilities.
